# Synthetic experiment card without numbers (linter selftest only)

Entirely invented. Not a real experiment.

## Mechanics

The invented widget is shown once in the synthetic surface, to everyone in
the test arm who reaches the branch where it can appear.

## Hypothesis

Showing the widget lifts the invented metric on the users who see it.

## Design and power

- Primary metric: invented metric per exposed user.
- Reach of the branch, expected effect size, resolvable difference and
  guardrail margin are all left unstated in this card.
